title: Jabba the Hutt
subtitle: Independent
franchise: Star Wars: Return of the Jedi
description: The great Jabba the Hutt was one of the most powerful and slimy gangsters in the galaxy. Jabba had no love for those that failed him, and he even put a price on Han Solo's head after he dumped his cargo after sighting an Imperial cruiser so high that the smuggler wasn't able to go near a civilized system without getting harassed by bounty hunters.
